dedupe_keys.name: pc miler truck routing mileage and mapping software trimble

description: PC*Miler is Trimble's commercial truck routing, mileage and mapping software, used by carriers, shippers and brokers as an industry standard for freight billing, driver pay and auditing. Contents: truck-specific map data and routing algorithms that respect commercial vehicle restrictions, practical, shortest or fastest routing, address-to-address routes, hours of service breaks built into plans, tolls, ETAs from predictive and real-time traffic with custom vehicle profiles, multi-stop optimisation and carbon footprint reporting. Coverage: commercial road networks, with global transit times named on the product page. Format and access: a web version on monthly subscription with batch processing of thousands of lanes, RESTful integration APIs and network or local server installations. Licence and cost: proprietary and paid; a free trial is offered. Caveats: map data and algorithms are closed, so results cannot be inspected, and the page gives no coverage statistics. Useful for network flow and optimisation studies of truck freight that need realistic truck-legal routes, distances and detours, for example rerouting after bridge or road closures. It relates to the Freight Analysis Framework and the open QNEAT3 QGIS network toolbox in the catalogue.
